source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Ιουνίου — «Οσία Ιουλίττα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and carries no years. She is neither of the two women of the name the corpus already keeps: `julitta-mother-of-cyricus`, kept on 15 July, and `julitta-of-caesarea`, kept on 31 July, both martyrs — this one the page calls Οσία and says died in peace. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and no hymn.
